limits: The Gemini save_load event does not actually serialize objects; the C# adapter roundtrips its pure state and the live probe separately exercises Scribe.
C# numerical adapter checks allocations, statuses, income and paid conservation; active contract arithmetic is exercised in game.
Patient pricing remains upstream; fixture billCoins is already final.

notes: Checked saved-wrapper keys against source, unique inside each class.
Surgery classification was simplified after the snapshot; saved wrappers did not change.
Claims of perfect invariants and universal absence of reference leaks are not adopted.
Death does not imply Discharge can never be invoked; cancelled/unregistered patients must not create a payable receipt.

playerGuideEdits: Initial buyout currently opens only for colony slaves; not an arbitrary colonist contract.
Shares are proportional with integer rounding, not exact real-number proportionality.
Removed internal AddToBill/Hamilton/halfRemainder/unattributed vocabulary from the short player guide.
Furniture or partial silver stacks do not guarantee blocking GenPlace Near; exact blockage is a test-only scenario.
A receipt already created at discharge is not cancelled automatically by a later death.
Manual early dismissal cancels the reward; paid checks must await normal discharge.
A labor-only surgery recipe may require the isolated Codex fixture; no such vanilla option is promised.
policy: A surgery requiring materials uses50% on the entire billed service. No duplicate upstream pricing calculation.
incidentsDecision: Deferred by user to the final story stage.
